title: chrysanthemum leucanthemum subsp. crassifolium
intro: Chrysanthemum leucanthemum subsp. crassifolium, commonly known as the Rough Leaved Oxeye Daisy, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the daisy family (Asteraceae). The Rough Leaved Oxeye Daisy is a perennial herb with potential health benefits, including its use as a natural anti-inflammatory agent to alleviate pain and reduce inflammation. Its therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids and sesquiterpenes, which have been reported to have antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of the Rough Leaved Oxeye Daisy, including flavonoids and sesquiterpenes, contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
